articles.title: The White House's crypto chief departs: State of Crypto
articles.snippet: Patrick Witt announced his departure from the White House last week.

articles.title: Wall Street freaked out Friday. VIX and bitcoin say the fear may fade Monday.
articles.snippet: Wall Street's fear gauge, the VIX index, spiked on Friday as stocks dropped. History says Friday panics usually fade on Monday. Seasonality and calm bitcoin suggest the same.

articles.title: Latvia eyes crypto tax payments in 2027 as parliament overhauls crypto taxation
articles.snippet: Parliament passed a law taxing crypto withdrawals above deposits rather than individual trades, featuring a one-time declaration mechanism.

articles.title: Stablecoin supply stalls, but payments jump 45% as Visa, Mastercard and Stripe connect crypto to cash
articles.snippet: Analytics firm Allium said stablecoin payments hit $482 billion this year so far, up 45%, as card spending surges and global payment firms add crypto rails.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s $100,000 year-end hope divides analysts as inflation clouds outlook
articles.snippet: Bitwise sees a potential return above $100,000, while LO:TECH expects a narrower trading range as interest-rate uncertainty weighs on the market.
